title: Long straddle into results, sold before the announcement
hypothesis: An ATM straddle on an F&O stock bought 3 to 10 sessions before its results date and sold at the close before it earns a positive mean return on the premium after charges and slippage.

mechanism.text: Implied volatility rises into a known event faster than theta decays the straddle.

evidence.source: Gao, Xing and Zhang, Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis 53(6)
evidence.finding: Straddles bought before earnings and sold before the announcement earn positive returns.

evidence.source: SEBI study of FY25-FY26 (as summarised on tradingqna.com)
evidence.finding: About 90% of option-buyer-only traders lost money.

universe.name: fno-stocks-pit
universe.rule: Stocks in the F&O list with a results date and a traded ATM strike on the entry session.

turnover.basis: costs about 5% of the premium paid a trade, mostly slippage, modelled per trade

prior_trials.basis: No option-buying rule has been run in this repo.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout mean return on premium above zero after charges over at least 100 events.

kill_criteria: Holdout mean return on premium at or below zero.
The return explained by the stock's move (delta) rather than the change in implied volatility.

prior.reason: A real mechanism in the US, untested in India; theta and wide stock option spreads work against it.

contamination: No results-day option trade has been run in this repo. Stock option prices for the holdout are unseen.
